Should we just let the waste and fraud continue, and was continuing to grow at a really unsustainable pace that was bankrupting the country or to fight the waste and fraud and try to get the country back on the right track. They're obviously not going to say -- admit that the reason that they're protesting is because they're receiving fraudulent money or they're the recipients of waste largesse. So now that said, I do think there's -- the large slug of work necessary to get the DOGE team in place and working in the government to get the financial house in order is mostly done. And I think starting probably in next month, May, my time allocation at DOGE will drop significantly. I'll have to continue doing it for I think we have the remainder of the President's term just to make sure that the waste and fraud that we stopped does not come roaring back, which we'll do if it has the chance. So I think I'll continue to spend a day or 2 per week on government matters for as long as the President would like me to do so, and as long as it is useful. So at Tesla, we've gone through many a crisis over the years and actually been through many near-death experiences. I think we probably were in the edge of death at least on maybe a dozen times. It's been so many times. This is not one of those times. We're not on edge of death, not even close. So there are some challenges, and I expect that this year will be -- there'll probably be some unexpected bumps this year. I remain extremely optimistic about the future of the company. TESLA, INC. It does actually make sense from a cost standpoint and from a logistics risk standpoint is to have the supply chains be at least located on the continent in which the car is built. And so we are, I think the least company -- the least affected car company with respect to tariffs, at least in most respects. I mean it remains to be seen. The team and I are laser-focused on bringing robotaxi to Austin in June. And we're going from -- once we can make the system work where you can have paid rides, fully autonomously with no one in the car in 1 city, that is a very scalable thing for us to go broadly within whatever jurisdiction allows us to operate.
